verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.bland.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a Bland documentation index. The docs are served as raw .md pages, and there are explicitly agent-oriented resources: a 'connect your agent' flow written for bots, an MCP server that can search the Bland docs, and a recommended coding-agent plugin. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that an agent pointed at these docs works well, and no evidence of an llms-full.txt or similar full-content export.
